stops.name: Chew Jetty
stops.reason: Wei gets the stilt houses in late afternoon light. There is nowhere to sit down for coffee out here, which is what Mei asked for.

stops.name: Armenian Street murals
stops.reason: The murals are Wei's shot and the coffee shops along the street cover Mei. It is a slow wander, and Ali would rather keep moving.

stops.name: Chulia Street night market
stops.reason: Covers Yap's street food and Wei's photo spots. Ali avoids pork, so his options here are limited.

stops.name: Gurney Drive hawker centre
stops.reason: More street food for Yap, and the halal stalls here work for Ali. Most of what Gurney is famous for is seafood, which Mei avoids.

stops.name: Line Clear Nasi Kandar
stops.reason: Yap's pick, and the best nasi kandar on the island. It is a standing-room alley, not the slow breakfast Mei wanted to start with.

stops.name: Kek Lok Si Temple
stops.reason: The pagoda tiers are the best frame Wei will get all trip, and the pace suits Ali. Getting up there is a long climb, and Yap avoids hiking.

stops.name: Penang Hill funicular
stops.reason: Wei gets the island panorama and Ali gets a full afternoon. There is a lot of walking at the top for Yap, and it takes the whole afternoon Mei had earmarked for cafes.

stops.name: China House
stops.reason: Mei's cafe stop, and the cake counter is worth the detour for Yap too. It runs through the last of the good light, so Wei shoots nothing.

stops.name: Batu Ferringhi beach
stops.reason: A slow morning for Mei with the coastline for Wei. It is a soft start to the day, and Ali would rather have packed something in.

stops.name: Tropical Spice Garden
stops.reason: Shaded garden trails suit Mei, and it gives Ali a real stop rather than a photo pause. The trails climb, which Yap avoids.

stops.name: Kimberley Street food street
stops.reason: Yap's last street food run, with enough non-pork stalls to keep Ali fed. It is dark and cramped, so there is little here for Wei to shoot.
